messages:
elaine: quick follow after today's town huddle — two comp/benefits Qs: 1) when are merit increases applied (pay cycle timing?) and 2) someone mentioned potential equity schedule changes — did I hear that right? also a 401k match eligibility timing question. can someone confirm? thanks!

maria (People Ops): thanks @elaine! short answers: merit increases are applied on the next payroll after calibration (typically 1–2 pay cycles depending on processing). the stock plan is unchanged for now — still a 4-year vest with a 1-year cliff; no immediate company-wide changes. 401k matching eligibility starts after 60 days per the benefits plan. i'll drop the handbook links in a sec and we'll cover more in office hours.

elaine: super helpful — can you drop the links? i'll share with my ICs.

maria (People Ops): here you go — <https://redwood.company/handbook/comp/merit-timeline> , <https://redwood.company/handbook/equity/vesting> , <https://redwood.company/handbook/benefits/401k>. also we have office hours tomorrow 11:00 AM PT if folks want to ask live questions.

sam: managers — heads up: the performance calibration doc was updated this morning; if you didn't receive the calibration invite check your calendar and ping me. also FYI there's a tooling preview: run `comp_report --team=<your-team>` in HR tools to preview your team's ranges (managers only).

jules: curious — any change to how promotions affect equity or comp? e.g., will promo bumps be prorated if off-cycle?

maria (People Ops): promotions are applied on the promo effective date. base increases may be prorated for off-cycle promos. equity grants for promotions are handled case-by-case; managers should submit promo packets with rationale by the end of the month so we can review for potential grants. we'll also cover promo timelines in office hours.

alex: small nit — the 'merit bands' doc still references older grade labels (like "grade 3"). will that labeling change be published? a candidate asked today.

karen: question from a PM on leave: if someone was out on LOA during calibration, how is their review handled?

sam: great question — managers should add LOA context to the calibration packet. if someone missed calibration due to an approved LOA, managers can flag them for retro consideration; ping me + @maria and we'll queue a review.

peopleops-bot: Reminder posted: People Ops office hours tomorrow 11:00 AM PT — add to calendar: <https://calendar.redwood.company/peopleops-officehours> :bell:

elaine: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll DM for any followups. :pray:
